## Working of Recursion

Here's how the previous example works:

![Working of infinite recursion in Python](data:image/png;base64,)

There are a couple of things we need to understand here.

1. Though we are calling the same print_variable() function in our program. Think of these functions as different functions.
2. Since variables inside a function are local to it. The text variable in the different print_variable() functions are also local to respective print_variable() functions.

Next, we will create another example of infinite recursion.
